defects.title: Cross-Account Draft Storage Leak
defects.discovery: Initial audit showed useState initialized once; user.id changes did not re-initialize or clear previous user's draft in memory.
defects.resolution: Added prevUserIdRef tracking in EventCreatePage.jsx. When user?.id changes, memory draft is reset and reloaded for new user.

defects.title: Duplicate Event Creation on Refresh after Cover Upload Failure
defects.discovery: If POST /api/events succeeds but cover upload fails, pendingEventId was held only in memory. Browser refresh lost it, causing user to resubmit and duplicate event.
defects.resolution: Persisted pendingEventId into sessionStorage (koupreng_pending_event_<userId>) and restored it on mount with recovery banner.

defects.title: Unresolved Premium Template Entitlement Gate Rendered Active 'Select' Button
defects.discovery: Checking access[template.id] === false let undefined state fall through, rendering an active 'Select' button before entitlements loaded.
defects.resolution: Explicitly checked access[template.id] === true before enabling 'Select'; rendered disabled 'Verifying access...' for undefined.

defects.title: Mobile Viewport Sticky Bottom Bar Obscuring Focused Input
defects.discovery: On narrow screens, the sticky actions bar at bottom covered inputs when scrolling to bottom of step 1/2.
defects.resolution: Added scroll-padding-bottom: 100px and scroll-padding-top: 24px to .event-create in EventCreatePage.css.

defects.title: Draft Cover Photo Non-Persistence Transparency
defects.discovery: Browser Blob URLs for attached files cannot persist across sessions without cloud draft upload.
defects.resolution: Added explicit draft photo notice banner informing the user that attached photo is kept in session memory only.
